title: Why metrics are a MUST HAVE for a resume ✍️
description:
If you're struggling to get interviews using your current resume, take a look at each bullet point achievement and ask yourself:

“Is there a metric I can add here?”

In each role, you've had deadlines, hit goals, or even tackled multiple projects. How can you showcase metrics to support your experience? Use the Achievement Assistant tool in the Resume Builder to build your achievements manually using our go-to formula: success verb + noun + metric + outcome. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #resumetips #entrylevel
